description: Shared technical module for app composition and startup: entrypoints, router, i18n, bootstrap state, GraphView, configuration, and desktop host wiring. Feature implementations remain in their own records.

characterizationScenarios.name: Graph canvas restores detached Vue node elements and retains focus and link-drag sources while panning
Bootstrap loads i18n, waits for cloud auth with a bounded retry, and loads settings and workflows once
Root app component and graph view wire reconnect handling, output refresh, and global providers
i18n setup merges custom node translations, resolves safe translations, and keeps source keys in the English catalog
Endpoint configuration falls back for servers without override keys and the build publishes only the cloud canonical tag

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and runtime behavior without granting public entry points.
